mapper.sql: id, public_id, username, password_hash, display_name, role_code, status, failed_count, locked_until, version, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM admin_user WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM admin_user WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM admin_user WHERE public_id = #{publicId} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE admin_user SET failed_count = failed_count + 1, locked_until = CASE WHEN failed_count + 1 >= #{threshold} THEN #{lockedUntil} ELSE locked_until END WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE admin_user SET failed_count = 0, locked_until = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
